dataTraining.dataTrainingDescriptionOWNCLASS: Sample data is a small number of locations where presence of the land use and land cover classes that you specify can be determined. Sample data informs the mapping process on how your classes can be distinguished in all locations throughout your mapping area. Prepare the sample data for land use and land cover classification in your mapping area. You can upload existing data or create samples directly in Luma through on-screen sampling.

dataTraining.recordedLULCDescriptionDEFAULTCLASS: Available sample data within your mapping area is summarized in the table below. Note that sample data from other locations throughout Indonesia are also used for mapping your area when classes from default classification scheme in Luma are used. Hence, Luma can still map your area despite potentially limited sample data availability.

lulcParams.RFVariableDesc: Random Forest is used to classify satellite images into LULC classes using training data. It works by combining many decision trees, which each make a prediction for every pixel. The final result is based on the majority vote from all trees, making the classification more accurate and reliable.

yourMap.modelAccuracyAssessmentDescriptionDEFAUL: The scores below show how accurately the mapping process distinguished your LULC classes. The scores are obtained from a pre-generated national LULC map of Indonesia. Your map is produced by clipping the national LULC map into your area of interest and reclassifying the default LULC classes to fit your selection of LULC classes.

yourMap.classLevelAccuracyIntro: Class-level accuracy can be used to assess model quality for specific classes. Besides the F1-score and G-mean, there are other accuracy metrics used to assess class-level accuracy:
yourMap.classLevelRecallBullet: Recall/Producer's Accuracy: This accuracy answers the question 'How well does the algorithm map the classes found in the field?'. It provides information about omission errors, i.e. when data from the correct class goes undetected or is missed by the model.
yourMap.classLevelPrecisionBullet: Precision/User's Accuracy: This accuracy answers the question 'How trustworthy is the classification result of a given class?'. It provides information about commission errors, i.e. when the model misclassifies by placing data from other classes into that class.

layerAndComposites.compositeSubtitle: Composites of satellite imagery are generated through vertically stacking images across different electromagnetic spectrum bands and horizontally combining patches of cloud-free images. The resulting composite highlights certain features of land use and land cover to assist further analysis.
layerAndComposites.cloudCoverInCompositeDescription:
The composites are horizontal combination of cloud-free patches from all available satellite images within the limit of maximum cloudy areas. The resulting composite shows the clearest possible view based on the recorded satellite imagery.

White spots in the scene show how much of the image is covered by clouds as the satellite sensors cannot reach the Earth surface underneath.
